case_number: Civil Appeal No. of 2022 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) No.5345 of 2019)

parties.respondent: Nunu Chand Mahto @ Nemchand Mahto & Ors.

summary: The appellant, mother of a 12-year-old child who died in a road accident, challenged the adequacy of compensation awarded by MACT and upheld by the High Court. The Supreme Court found the compensation inadequate, noting the child was a brilliant student likely to secure a government job. Relying on precedent, it enhanced compensation by applying a notional income of Rs. 30,000 with a multiplier of 15, adding conventional heads, resulting in total compensation of Rs. 5,00,000. The Court emphasized that claimed amount does not cap just compensation and awarded interest on the enhanced amount.
legal_provisions_cited: Sections 140, 166 read with Section 171 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
R.K. Malik vs. Kiran Pal (2009) 14 SCC 1
Sarla Verma vs. Delhi Transport Corporation (2009) 6 SCC 121
Lata Wadhwa vs. State of Bihar (2001) 8 SCC 197
M.S. Grewal vs. Deep Chand Sood (2001) 8 SCC 151
Taff Vale Rly. vs. Jenkins 1913 AC 1
Kurvan Ansari vs. Shyam Kishore Murmu (2022) 1 SCC 317
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation enhanced from Rs. 2,00,000 to Rs. 5,00,000. Respondent No. 4 (United India Insurance Company) to pay the enhanced amount of Rs. 3,00,000 with interest @7% p.a. from the date of Claim Petition till realization within four weeks. Parties to bear their own costs.
